subject: EvOne.ma / EVPlug access-network scope

facts.wording_scope: stations where the EVPlug charge card can be used

modeling.cpo_operator: station-specific; never infer EVPlug from visibility in EVOne
modeling.tariff_channel: EVOne/EVPlug eMSP tariff when sourced from app; native CPO tariff remains separate
modeling.status_source: EVOne/EVPlug roaming status when sourced from app; prefer native CPO status when available

interpretation: Official EVPlug wording establishes EVOne/EVPlug primarily as a broad access/eMSP layer across public charging networks, not proof that EVPlug is CPO for every visible station. The existing production status policy remains unchanged: keep Available, Occupied or Charging; exclude Faulted, Offline, Unknown and Unavailable from production while retaining them for diagnostics.
